title: ABBA Reasoning Substrate Binding Contract
rules: The binder prepares an event envelope but does not call the database.
The authority gate independently evaluates authority, policy and consent.
The execution gateway remains the only consequential execution boundary.
Reasoning evidence is preserved in event provenance and binding records.
A recommendation does not itself become a decision.
A decision does not itself grant authority.
Binding failure never mutates canonical state.
Recovery-required execution is never silently replayed.
